about: CBR copies of the same performance as a review-dashboard recording (surah-sources/generate-timed-preview.mjs --copies). openings: where the recitation begins in a copy that starts with other audio (ayah 1 plays from there). transfers: the original's accepted timing moved by the measured offset, used only while the copy's own alignment agrees with it. Development preview only.

openings.evidence: same performance as MP3Quran islam-sobhi 021 (compare.py: every piece at a constant lag); the copy plays the original's 0:00 at 11950 ms (median offset of all 111 ayah starts, own alignment vs the accepted timing, max deviation 410 ms); the audio before it ends in silence before that point and the first recitation sound after it falls where the original's does (within 20 ms)

same performance (constant offset; own alignment within 10 ms of the accepted timing at every start from ayah 2); the copy's own alignment squeezed ayah 1 (score 0.12, 44 ms per letter), so the original's accepted ayah-1 onset is used
